import pathlib
OLD = pathlib.Path(r"C:\Users\lcvle\lcv-workspace\github-operations\temp\old-master.txt").read_text(encoding="utf-8", newline="")

a = pathlib.Path("AGENTS.md").read_bytes(); c = pathlib.Path("CLAUDE.md").read_bytes()
if a != c: raise SystemExit("AGENTS.md != CLAUDE.md after edit")
print("edited ok")
